main:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: Still artwork approval concept for Travary onboarding sign-in, not an animation and not a production screenshot.
Primary request: Generate one exceptionally polished tall portrait mobile app screen, about 9:19.5 aspect ratio, flat straight-on full-bleed artwork. This is a new sign-in beat BETWEEN an existing saved-booking scene and the paywall. Match the attached approved art closely.
Input images: Image 1 is a reference for Travi's exact identity, lush Bali paper theatre and the preceding scene. Image 2 is a reference for the following approved pass desk and material language. Both are style/continuity references, not images to alter. Preserve the approved coral ribbed-spinner suitcase mascot and the same handcrafted rich paper theatre.
Scene/backdrop: Quiet textured deep teal upper sky, cream cut-paper clouds, coral-orange sun, Balinese temples and rice terraces at left, ocean behind, cream sandy paper foreground. Match the same camera and horizon as the references. Do not invent a different world or a generic gradient.
Subject and useful character acting: Travi, the SAME coral hard-shell ribbed spinner with four navy wheels, navy edging, telescopic navy handle with brass rails, brass hardware, cream palm luggage tag and folded-paper arms. In the middle hero region, he is at right, cheerfully concentrating with big bright eyes on a navy travel folio at left. One hand steadies the folio and the other offers a small blank cream luggage tag with a simple embossed person silhouette, about to attach it to the folio's brass loop. This implies linking the holiday to its traveller, NOT a secure vault or document backup. A single cream corner of the just-filed booking peeks out of the folio. He has a charming eager tilt and an affectionate useful expression, not a generic idle grin. Keep his suitcase silhouette recognisable. No extra characters.
Composition/framing: top 31 percent calm teal for wordmark, headline and one short subtitle. Middle 37 percent contains the connected paper landscape and Travi/folio action, both fully clear. Lower 32 percent calm cream foreground with three wide readable standard sign-in buttons, generous spacing, guest link and short footer. All typography exactly horizontal, not printed at an odd angle on props. Do not put a frame, handset, notch or desktop around the image. This needs to read beautifully as a real mobile app screen at 430px width.
Text (verbatim): small cream serif wordmark "Travary". Large elegant cream/coral serif heading on three well-spaced centered lines: "Keep your" / "holiday" / "with you." The first two lines cream, the last coral. Smaller cream subtitle on two lines "Sign in to find your plan" / "on another phone." Lower controls: standard black Apple button with white Apple symbol and "Continue with Apple"; standard white Google button with small multicolour G mark and dark "Continue with Google"; cream outlined email button with navy envelope icon and "Continue with email". Below these, a clearly readable underlined navy link "Continue as a guest". Small navy footer "Signing in is free."
Materials/textures: premium dimensional sculpted cut paper, ribbed folded coral shell, tactile paper grain, navy linen folio, brass accents, warm holiday light. Provider buttons are clear familiar conventional controls, not decorative tilted tickets. Type should be refined, not squeezed.
Constraints: This is an inviting ACCOUNT scene, NOT the paywall. No pass prices, paywall tickets, invented testimonials, percentages, fake booking barcodes, giant lock, shield, cyber-security graphics, floating cloud upload icons, confetti or marketing claims about file backup. No claims like "secure", "encrypted", "backed up", "protected", "saved to account" before actual sign-in. All words must be correctly spelled and crisp. Only this still composition; no video.
email:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: STILL concept for the email branch of the Travary pre-paywall sign-in, for owner approval. No animation, no implementation claim.
Input images: Image 1 is the just-generated main account invitation. Keep its EXACT Travi character, coral suitcase/navy trim/brass hardware/palm tag, navy folio, Bali scenery, paper materials, warm holiday palette and typography family. Image 2 is the approved neighbouring pass desk, a continuity reference only.
Primary request: Make one tall flat straight-on full-bleed portrait mobile screen, approx 9:19.5, showing what happens after "Continue with email". Propose a simple PASSWORDLESS EMAIL LINK, not a password form. This should feel like the next useful page in the same warm paper-theatre holiday story.
Composition: Same teal sky and colourful Bali paper-theatre scenery, but the cream paper form now takes centre stage in the lower half, perfectly parallel to the screen and completely horizontal. Keep a calm large teal upper heading region. In the middle zone Travi is a little smaller, cheerfully peeking around the RIGHT edge of the navy folio and holding out one small cream paper envelope in his folded-paper hand, like an eager porter waiting to deliver a useful note. His eyes look towards the email field and envelope; his face is enthusiastic and patient. The folio remains at left, with the same unlabelled luggage tag nearby. No new character or mail mascot. Physical props have paper depth; UI fields stay flat and aligned.
Text verbatim: small cream wordmark "Travary". Centered elegant cream serif heading "One little link." and coral serif line "And you're in." Subtitle "Enter your email to sign in." In the cream form area, a navy label "Email address" above one generous straight outlined field with placeholder "you@example.com". One full-width navy notched button reading "Email me a sign-in link". Short body copy "No password to remember." Beneath, a clearly readable underlined navy link "Back to sign-in options" and another smaller underlined link "Continue as a guest".
Layout should be clean and practical for 430px phones: generous field, comfortable targets, compact supporting copy, room below the form. The form can scroll above a keyboard in implementation; do not draw a keyboard or device frame into this still. No printed angled text on a folio. No imaginary sent-success state: the envelope has not been sent yet, and NO tick or "sent" message.
Style: Match the reference's premium handcrafted sculpted cut-paper theatre, rich tactility, bright teal/coral/cream/navy, brass detailing and delighted coral ribbed luggage. Mature editorial serif headline with readable native-style field/button text. Warm holiday anticipation, not a security or corporate identity page.
Avoid: passwords, name/country questionnaire, extra fields, provider badges on this email detail page, price or paywall content, false automatic backup claims, lock/shield/cloud-upload graphics, fake personal emails, animation arrows, ornate unreadable labels, empty plain background, invented brand, extra digits/characters, watermark. Generate only one still image with correct clear text.
transition:
Use case: ui-mockup / illustration-story.
Asset type: STILL TRANSITION KEYFRAME APPROVAL BOARD. Not animation. Show proposed entry and exit of Travary's new account invitation before its approved pass desk.
Primary request: Create one premium wide landscape board with FOUR equally sized tall 9:16 portrait mobile compositions side by side, thin cream gutters, no handset/device mockups, no arrows and no explanatory typography outside the panels. Each portrait is a keyframe in ONE CONTINUOUS scene. The third is a brief inline completion acting beat, not another onboarding question/screen. This is for owner approval of choreography before video generation.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved saved-booking scene, locks its geography, suitcase character and existing navy folio at lower left. Image 2 is the new proposed account invitation, locks the sign-in scene and tag offer. Image 3 is the exact existing approved paywall artwork, locks the end frame. They are reference images, not edit targets.
Strong continuity constraints: Keep the same teal textured sky, Balinese temples/terraces/palms at left, mountain/ocean and orange sun behind, cream sand floor, same straight-on camera, horizon line, landscape scale and lighting throughout. Do NOT zoom or move the whole background between frames. Keep Travi's head/feet anchors and the navy folio at the same approximate positions across the last three panels. No new scenery reveal, no different country, no expanding phone/perspective. Make it feel like the SAME actual holiday and objects passed through the sequence.
Character identity: exact same CORAL RIBBED SPINNER suitcase with telescopic navy handle/brass rails, navy trim and four wheels, brass fittings, cream palm tag, folded-paper arms, friendly large bright black/white eyes and navy eyebrows, happy expressive mouth. He acts with useful glances and hands, not the same inert grin repeated four times.
PANEL 1 — Saved booking / leaving proof: calm upper Travary wordmark, large cream/coral serif "That's one" / "bit handled." Travi at right warmly glancing down at the single cream booking card he is lowering towards the upright navy folio at left. The corner of the booking is already nearly filed into the folio. The booking card has only a small abstract navy line and no fake personal details or prices. Lower region has a simple navy notched button labelled "Let's sort the rest". This frame proposes the physical bridge from existing proof into the account scene, with useful card filing, not disappearance.
PANEL 2 — Account invitation / waiting: upper Travary and cream/coral serif headline "Keep your holiday" / "with you." Subtitle "Sign in to find your plan on another phone." Travi is eagerly offering the small cream luggage tag with an embossed person silhouette, as in reference 2, beside the navy folio; his eyes notice the tag. The booking corner remains just visible. Lower cream region has three straight aligned conventional controls: black "Continue with Apple", white "Continue with Google", outlined cream "Continue with email", then an underlined "Continue as a guest". Keep all text horizontal and sharp.
PANEL 3 — Successful linking / inline acting beat: same exact account composition and camera, now Travi has neatly slipped the identity tag into the folio's INNER loop and is closing its brass clasp with one hand. His eyes briefly close in an affectionate delighted smile, his posture says a little proud "done". The tag is mostly tucked into the folio rather than growing into a giant security icon. Upper heading "Your holiday." in cream and "Linked to you." in coral. Lower cream region carries a small navy check with "Signed in" only; no new decision or extra signup form. This represents ACTUAL successful authentication ONLY. No "documents backed up", shield/lock, uploaded file claim or fake data. A guest route will omit this check/tag-link confirmation and go directly from invitation to the same pass desk; do not draw guest success in this board.
PANEL 4 — Exact approved pass desk landing: reproduce reference 3's layout, unchanged camera/horizon/scenery, Travi upright at right with palm open towards the traveller, the navy folio at left closed with ONLY its original palm decoration and no outside identity tag, quiet upper area containing Travary and cream/coral serif "Shall I help" / "with the rest?" and "Less typing. More holiday." Lower cream area has TWO original physical pass tickets, coral palm stub then navy palm stub. The entire ticket lettering and price areas MUST REMAIN BLANK because titles/prices are live RevenueCat controls. Beneath them a navy notched button with a completely blank label area. Do NOT include dollar signs, prices, US, pass names, renewal terms, selection marks or extra metadata. This is a clean approved landing reference, not a redesign of the paywall.
Style: high-end sculpted folded-paper theatre, tactile ribbed coral and cream paper texture, dimensional foliage, navy linen, restrained brass, warm happy holiday light, consistent rich saturation. All UI and headings aligned straight to the viewport with calm space; no text tilted on props. No additional mascots, generic gradient, flat vector cartoon, confetti, cloud upload gimmicks, giant badges, fake boarding barcodes, watermark or video icons. Output one still board only.
